items.title_en: SpiceJet Passengers Protest At Airports Over Delays, Cancellations And Baggage Issues | Videos Go Viral
items.title_zh: 香料航空乘客在机场抗议延误、取消和行李问题Videos Go Viral
items.summary_en: Passengers at Mumbai and Delhi airports raised slogans against SpiceJet after multiple flight cancellations, delays, and baggage issues left many stranded.
items.summary_zh: 多次航班取消、延误和行李问题导致许多人滞留，孟买和德里机场的乘客高举反对香料航空的口号。
